What We Will Track

The goal is not only to track what was installed, but to understand how well the program is being used and where support is needed. Every metric is intended to help the CSR implementation team decide what to strengthen, where to intervene and whether the intended learning environment is actually improving.

Sentinel AI Monitoring, Evidence & Outcome Intelligence

Sentinel gives the CSR team, foundation and donor a direct window into what is happening inside the supported classrooms. The objective is not merely to confirm that devices are switched on, but to understand whether learners are attending, whether classrooms are active, how students are participating, how teaching practice is evolving, and where the program needs intervention.
From deployment visibility to real classroom evidence

CSR teams can view live or recorded classroom sessions, review activity on a timeline and access classroom-level evidence without waiting for periodic field visits. This creates a stronger layer of transparency and allows implementation teams to identify issues earlier.

Attendance & PresenceUnderstand whether intended beneficiaries are actually attending the supported classrooms and how attendance changes over time.
Engagement & ParticipationTrack whether students are participating, asking questions, staying on task and becoming more engaged through the intervention.
Teaching PracticeReview instructional activity, explanation, interaction, questioning and classroom practice to identify where teacher support may be useful.
Program ImprovementCompare trends before and after training, content interventions or field support to understand whether implementation quality is improving.
Outcome Intelligence ReportsClassroom behaviour, student engagement, teaching practice, attendance, utilisation and lesson-level insights can be reviewed together so the CSR team sees educational activity rather than only technology usage.
CSR Impact AI AgentAn AI assistant sits on top of project data so CSR heads and implementation officers can ask questions in plain language and immediately understand progress, risks and areas needing support.

CSR Impact AI Agent — Ask the Program Anything

Every CSR program can have a dedicated impact assistant powered by Sentinel and project data. Instead of searching through multiple dashboards or waiting for a monthly report, authorised CSR stakeholders can ask direct questions and receive a concise answer with the relevant classroom, school or program context.
Questions the impact agent can answer

The agent turns implementation data into decision support. It can surface progress at school, district or overall-program level and help the CSR team move quickly from a question to an action.

How many students attended today?
Which classrooms are not functioning well?
How has engagement changed this month?
Which teachers may need refresher training?
Are remote classrooms joining expert sessions regularly?
Which schools need immediate implementation support?
